name: LightDock
summary: Macromolecular docking with optional experimental restraints.

steps: Check the current maintainer README and platform/dependency requirements; Windows is not officially supported there.
Create an isolated Python environment and install a reviewed LightDock release with pip; consider optional MPI support only if requested.
Use the official tutorials to prepare receptor, ligand, and any restraints.
install.verify_note: Run the documented command-line help and, if requested, a small maintainer tutorial in a scratch directory.

notes: Do not infer that a docking score establishes physical binding. MPI and native dependencies vary by system.
